nodes.rationale: Never submit/replace/cancel/close orders or change account settings without explicit owner approval of a later milestone; never enable live trading; no claims of unattended monitoring without a verified running service.

nodes.label: Read-only Alpaca Client Rule (HTTP GET only)
nodes.norm_label: read-only alpaca client rule (http get only)
nodes.rationale: No write methods may be added to the client so data access cannot place or alter orders.

nodes.label: Completed Session Rule (15 min after close, SIP delay)
nodes.norm_label: completed session rule (15 min after close, sip delay)
nodes.rationale: Alpaca free plan delays SIP data, so a session is only treated as complete 15 minutes after its close.

nodes.label: Data Feeds: SIP (consolidated) vs IEX (single exchange)
nodes.norm_label: data feeds: sip (consolidated) vs iex (single exchange)
nodes.rationale: Feed is always requested explicitly and recorded; never switch feeds silently on error, to keep data provenance honest.

nodes.label: 1-Minute Bar Coverage ([open, close), trade-only bars)
nodes.rationale: Alpaca only creates a bar when a trade occurs, so a missing minute may mean no trades on that feed rather than lost data; IEX has many more empty minutes.

nodes.label: XNYS Exchange Calendar (America/New_York, UTC + ET timestamps)
nodes.norm_label: xnys exchange calendar (america/new_york, utc + et timestamps)

nodes.label: Known Limitations (pandas deprecation warning, OneDrive venv, feed not echoed)
nodes.norm_label: known limitations (pandas deprecation warning, onedrive venv, feed not echoed)

nodes.label: Credential Handling (APCA_API_KEY_ID / APCA_API_SECRET_KEY in .env)
nodes.rationale: Keys only in git-ignored .env or environment; never printed, logged, screenshotted, committed or asked for in chat; account snapshots exclude id and account_number.

nodes.label: Synthetic Test Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Fixtures are labeled synthetic and are never evidence of market behavior or performance.
